description: Admin CLI tool for database management (orgs, users, activity templates, boredom config) + dashboard data flow demonstration

currentState.summary: CLI has basic DB management commands but lacks admin CRUD operations. Dashboard data flow is functional but not fully demonstrated end-to-end with Playwright automation.

components.currentBehavior: Has db group with init-schema, validate, status commands. Server start/stop commands exist.
components.desiredBehavior: Should have admin group with commands for: org create/list/update, user create/list/assign, template manage, boredom config.
components.gap: Missing admin command group and all CRUD subcommands

components.currentBehavior: Full CRUD available: create_organization, get_organization, list_organizations, update_organization, delete_organization, get_organization_stats
components.desiredBehavior: Expose via CLI commands for admin use
components.gap: Operations exist but not exposed in CLI

components.currentBehavior: Full CRUD: create_template_record, get_template_by_variant_id, list_all_templates, update_template_record, delete_template_record
components.desiredBehavior: CLI commands to list templates, enable/disable for boredom system, set priority flags
components.gap: No CLI exposure, no boredom eligibility field in schema

components.currentBehavior: Schema defines users table with user_id, email, password_hash, org_id, role, is_active, etc.
components.desiredBehavior: CLI commands to create users, assign to orgs, update roles, deactivate accounts
components.gap: No user_ops.py module, no CLI commands

components.currentBehavior: Fetches activities via metabob_fetch_boredom_activities MCP tool with hardcoded filters (priority_threshold: 0.6, max_activities: 5)
components.desiredBehavior: Backend should allow admin to configure which templates are boredom-eligible, set priority scores, configure thresholds
components.gap: No admin API to configure boredom eligibility

components.currentBehavior: Likely has metabob_fetch_boredom_activities endpoint that queries templates
components.desiredBehavior: Should filter by boredom_eligible flag, respect admin-configured priorities
components.gap: Need to verify endpoint logic and add boredom filtering

components.currentBehavior: Shows Playwright navigation to app.metabob.local, login attempts, screenshot captures. Auth blocked without valid credentials.
components.desiredBehavior: Full end-to-end demonstration: login → navigate to activity history → view aggregated data → verify data flow from devbob
components.gap: Need to configure local mode or create test user to bypass auth

components.currentBehavior: Documents the flow: OpenCode CLI → POST /v2/activities/content → SurrealDB → GET /auth/orgs/{org_id}/activity → Redis Cache → Dashboard UI
components.desiredBehavior: Playwright automation demonstrates this flow visually with real data
components.gap: Need Playwright script to automate login, navigation, data verification

adminCLI.flow: start_server admin org create → organization_ops.create_organization() → SurrealDB.organizations → Success

userManagement.flow: start_server admin user create → user_ops.create_user() → bcrypt.hash(password) → SurrealDB.users → Success
userManagement.exitPoint: User record created with hashed password

boredomSelection.flow: BoredomManager.fetchBoredomActivities() → metabob_fetch_boredom_activities → GET /api/boredom/activities?filter=boredom_eligible=true → SurrealDB query → Return prioritized list

dashboardDataFlow.flow: OpenCode execution → POST /v2/activities/content → SurrealDB.activity_content → Dashboard: GET /auth/orgs/{org_id}/activity → Redis cache (60s TTL) → SurrealDB (on miss) → JSON response → Timeline render

playwrightDemo.flow: playwright.navigate(app.metabob.local) → login → click('Activity History') → screenshot → verify data → validate end-to-end flow

adminCLI: start_server admin org create --name='Test Org' → Creates organization in SurrealDB
start_server admin org list → Shows all organizations
start_server admin user create --email=admin@example.com --name='Admin User' --org-id=org-123 → Creates user with hashed password
start_server admin user assign --user-id=user-123 --org-id=org-456 --role=admin → Assigns user to org
start_server admin template list --org-id=org-123 → Lists templates scoped to org
start_server admin template set-boredom --template-id=hello-world --enable → Sets boredom_eligible=true
start_server admin boredom config --priority-threshold=0.7 → Configures boredom system
